auth.metaDescription: Sign in to your traveller account to find your bookings.
auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Access your traveller account.
auth.errorForbiddenRole: This is not a traveller account. Please use the professional workspace.
auth.errorUnavailable: Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
auth.guestErrorGeneric: We could not save your details. Please try again.

account.title: My account
account.comingSoon: Your bookings and invoices will appear here soon.
account.unavailable: Your account area is temporarily unavailable.

booking.pricePromise: This total is the amount that will be charged: no extra fees appear later. The stay tax breakdown is not provided by the property yet.
booking.policyFallbackSummary: Cancellation and refund conditions are set by the property.
booking.policyFallbackDetail: They are not published on the platform yet, so we cannot detail them here.
booking.policyRefundable: This booking is refundable under the property’s conditions.
booking.policyUnknown: Cancellation conditions are set by the property.
booking.availabilityToConfirm: Availability confirmed at the next step.
booking.unavailableNotice: This room is no longer available for these dates.
booking.unavailableTitle: This room is no longer available
booking.unavailableBody: It has just been booked, or it no longer matches your dates or your number of guests. Pick another room for this stay.
booking.overCapacityTitle: Too many guests for this room
booking.overCapacityBody: This room sleeps {capacity, plural, one {# guest} other {# guests}}, but there are {guests, plural, one {# traveller} other {# travellers}}. Reduce the number of guests or choose another room.
booking.notFoundBody: This room does not exist or is no longer offered for booking.
booking.degradedBody: We cannot calculate your total right now. Please try again in a moment.
booking.errorBody: Something went wrong while calculating your stay.
booking.stayRejectedBody: This stay cannot be quoted as it stands: its length or its dates fall outside the accepted limits. Adjust them below.
booking.invalidBody: Some details are missing to prepare your booking. Start again from the room you want.
booking.identifyIntro: Book as a guest — no account needed. You can create one later if you wish.
booking.guestEmailHelp: This is where we will send your booking confirmation. Please double-check it.
booking.confirmationNotice: We will send your confirmation to {email}.
booking.conflictTitle: An account already exists with this address
booking.conflictBody: Sign in to continue your booking, or use a different email address.
booking.paymentPlaceholder: Secure payment arrives at the next step of the funnel.

errors.roomRequired: The room to book could not be identified.
errors.datesRequired: Enter your check-in and check-out dates.
errors.checkInPast: The check-in date cannot be in the past.
errors.checkOutBeforeCheckIn: The check-out date must be after the check-in date.
errors.guestsMax: That number of guests is too high.

booking.sessionErrorTitle: We could not check your sign-in status
booking.sessionErrorBody: We do not know whether you are signed in. Please try again before continuing — creating a guest account now could duplicate your own.
booking.createIntro: We book your room and hold it while you complete payment.
booking.noChargeYet: No amount is charged at this step.
booking.reservedIntro: Your booking is recorded and awaiting payment. It will be confirmed once payment is completed.
booking.amountUnreliableHelp: We cannot render the amount reliably in this currency. We would rather show nothing than a wrong total.
booking.holdExpiredTitle: Your room is no longer held
booking.holdExpiredBody: The booking window has elapsed and the room was released. You can start a new booking.
booking.reservationCancelledBody: It is no longer awaiting payment and the room was released. No amount has been charged.
booking.reservationCancelledNotice: You can start a new booking for this stay.
booking.reservationSettledTitle: This booking is no longer awaiting payment
booking.reservationSettledBody: Its status changed since your last visit: there is nothing to pay on this screen.
booking.reservationStatusUnknownBody: We could not establish the exact state of this booking. As a precaution, payment is not offered.
booking.reservationStatusUnknownNotice: Load it again to get its real state.
booking.reservationMismatchTitle: This booking is for another stay
booking.reservationMismatchBody: The booking carried by this link does not match the room, the dates or the number of guests shown here. Open it as it stands, or start again from the stay shown.
booking.mustIdentifyBody: Your session is no longer active. Go back to the previous step to continue, without losing your stay.
booking.reservationLoadErrorBody: We could not retrieve this booking. You can start a new one for this stay.
booking.reservationLoadSessionTitle: Your session is no longer active
booking.reservationLoadSessionBody: We cannot read this booking back without a valid session. Identify yourself again: your booking and your stay are preserved.
booking.reservationLoadOutageBody: We could not reach our booking service. Your booking is not lost: try again rather than creating a second one.
booking.failurePriceChangedBody: The rate for this room changed: the total is now {total}. No amount has been charged.
booking.summaryOutdated: The total in the summary is out of date: only the new total shown above will apply.
booking.announceReserved: Your room is booked and held while you pay.
booking.announceHoldExpired: Your room is no longer held.
booking.announceReservationSettled: This booking is no longer awaiting payment.
booking.announceReservationStatusUnknown: The status of this booking is undetermined.

upsell.title: Add services
upsell.description: Optional — the services you pick are paid in one go with your room.
upsell.droppedNotice: One or more services are no longer available for your stay: they were removed and your room stays booked. The total below reflects that removal.
upsell.lockedNotice: Your payment is under way: services can no longer be changed here.

booking.announceReservationMismatch: The booking on this link is for another stay.
booking.preferencesIntro: Optional — this information travels with your booking request.
booking.specialRequestsPlaceholder: Late arrival, quiet room, high floor…
booking.specialRequestsHelp: The hotel reads these at the front desk. This is not a guarantee: nothing is reserved on this basis.
booking.communicationLocaleHelp: Your choice travels with your booking. It does not yet drive the language of the hotel’s emails and documents: those currently go out in the property’s usual language.
booking.preferencesLockedNotice: This information travels with your booking and can no longer be changed here. To update it, contact the hotel.
booking.preferencesDivergedNotice: Your reservation already existed: the saved requests above are what counts, not what you just typed.

room-unavailable.title: This room has just been booked
room-unavailable.body: It is no longer available for these dates. Other rooms in the hotel may suit you.

over-capacity.title: Too many guests for this room
over-capacity.body: This room does not accommodate your number of guests. Choose a larger room.

invalid-dates.title: Invalid dates
invalid-dates.body: The dates of your stay cannot be booked. Change them to continue.

room-not-found.title: Room not found
room-not-found.body: This room no longer exists in this hotel. Here are the other available rooms.

session-invalid.title: Session expired
session-invalid.body: Your session is no longer valid. Identify yourself again: your stay is preserved.

price-changed.title: The rate has changed
price-changed.body: The rate for this room changed since the summary was displayed. No amount has been charged.

rate-limited.title: Too many attempts
rate-limited.body: You made several attempts in a row. New attempts are temporarily blocked. No booking was created: you can pick your stay back up from the summary.

rejected.title: Your request was not accepted
rejected.body: The property did not accept this booking. No amount has been charged: check the details of your stay.

unavailable.title: Service temporarily unavailable
unavailable.body: We could not reach our booking service. No booking was created.

unknown.title: The booking did not go through
unknown.body: An unexpected error occurred. No booking was created.

booking.communicationLocaleAttachedNotice: This preference is kept, but the hotel currently writes in its usual language.
